src/main.c

The entry point enforces experiment order. Dataset generation is an explicit command; a normal benchmark cannot rewrite the answer labels.

Parse commands and validate numeric arguments

Section titled “Parse commands and validate numeric arguments”

strtoul parses numeric options, while the end pointer and errno reject trailing junk and overflow. Command handling separates a completed help/list request from an invalid argument. The manifest header must agree with the requested seed and dataset version.

Download complete source
1/** @file2 * [PM-Ma4iF8] Run order protects the experiment:3 * validate data/tests -> calibrate every policy -> freeze -> evaluate -> time -> report.4 * --generate is deliberately separate: an ordinary run cannot rewrite its labels.5 */6#include <errno.h>7#include <stdlib.h>8#include <string.h>9#include "pm.h"1011typedef enum { CLI_RUN, CLI_PRINTED_HELP, CLI_BAD_ARGUMENT } CliResult;12typedef struct { int generate; int self_test; } RequestedAction;1314static void usage(void) {15    puts("C99 property matching benchmark\n"16         "Usage: ./property_match_bench [options]\n"17         "  --help                 Show usage\n"18         "  --list-algorithms      List baseline and 12 algorithms\n"19         "  --self-test            Run parser, algorithms, resolver and binding tests\n"20         "  --benchmark            Calibrate, freeze policies, evaluate and time (default)\n"21         "  --generate             Explicitly regenerate the two labeled manifests\n"22         "  --seed N               Manifest generation seed (default 42)\n"23         "  --repetitions N        Timing repetitions, 1..100 (default 5)\n"24         "  --wrong-cost N         Cost of dangerous acceptance (default 100)\n"25         "  --reject-cost N        Cost of unnecessary rejection (default 1)\n"26         "  --report PATH          Markdown output (default reports/evaluation.md)\n"27         "  --csv PATH             Per-case CSV (default reports/results.csv)\n"28         "Run from the project directory. Companion CSVs always go under reports/.");29}3031/** Reject overflow and trailing junk rather than quietly accepting a partial number. */32static int unsigned_arg(const char *text, unsigned long *value, unsigned long maximum) {33    char *end;34    if (!*text || *text == '-') return 0;35    errno = 0;36    *value = strtoul(text, &end, 10);37    return !errno && !*end && *value <= maximum;38}3940/** Parse flags here so main reads as experiment steps instead of string comparisons. */41static CliResult read_arguments(int argc, char **argv, Options *options, RequestedAction *action) {42    int index;43    for (index = 1; index < argc; ++index) {44        const char *argument = argv[index];45        int has_value = index + 1 < argc;46        int output_option = !strcmp(argument, "--report") || !strcmp(argument, "--csv");47        int numeric_option = !strcmp(argument, "--seed") || !strcmp(argument, "--repetitions") ||48                             !strcmp(argument, "--wrong-cost") || !strcmp(argument, "--reject-cost");49        if (!strcmp(argument, "--help")) { usage(); return CLI_PRINTED_HELP; }50        if (!strcmp(argument, "--list-algorithms")) {51            size_t algorithm;52            for (algorithm = 0; algorithm < ALGORITHMS; ++algorithm) {53                printf("%-6s %s\n", algorithms[algorithm].id, algorithms[algorithm].name);54            }55            return CLI_PRINTED_HELP;56        }57        if (!strcmp(argument, "--self-test")) { action->self_test = 1; continue; }58        if (!strcmp(argument, "--generate")) { action->generate = 1; continue; }59        if (!strcmp(argument, "--benchmark")) continue;60        if (has_value && output_option) {61            if (!strcmp(argument, "--report")) options->report = argv[++index];62            else options->csv = argv[++index];63            continue;64        }65        if (has_value && numeric_option) {66            unsigned long value;67            if (!unsigned_arg(argv[++index], &value, UINT32_MAX)) {68                fprintf(stderr, "invalid numeric option %s\n", argument);69                return CLI_BAD_ARGUMENT;70            }71            if (!strcmp(argument, "--seed")) options->seed = (uint32_t)value;72            else if (!strcmp(argument, "--repetitions")) {73                if (!value || value > 100) return CLI_BAD_ARGUMENT;74                options->repetitions = (unsigned)value;75            } else if (!strcmp(argument, "--wrong-cost")) options->costs.severe = (double)value;76            else options->costs.rejection = (double)value;77            continue;78        }79        fprintf(stderr, "unknown or incomplete option: %s\n", argument);80        return CLI_BAD_ARGUMENT;81    }82    return CLI_RUN;83}8485/** A different seed/version needs explicit regeneration, never silent replacement. */86static int seed_matches(const char *path, uint32_t seed) {87    FILE *file = fopen(path, "r");88    char line[256], expected[128];89    int matches;90    if (!file) return 0;91    (void)snprintf(expected, sizeof expected, "# dataset=%s;seed=%u;", DATA_VERSION, (unsigned)seed);92    matches = fgets(line, sizeof line, file) != NULL && !strncmp(line, expected, strlen(expected));93    fclose(file);94    return matches;95}96

Freeze every calibrated policy before held-out evaluation

Section titled “Freeze every calibrated policy before held-out evaluation”

calibrate_all completes and closes the grid CSV first. main then evaluates the held-out manifest with those frozen policies and measures each method. Correctness tests and dataset validation run before calibration. A failed stage exits nonzero instead of generating a plausible report from partial results.

Reference for the contracts used in this file

Section titled “Reference for the contracts used in this file”

The reproduction instructions explain the seed, frozen manifests and command-line modes. Generation is explicit so an ordinary benchmark cannot rewrite its answer key. Open reference.

97/** Finish the complete grid file before any held-out inputs are evaluated. */98static int calibrate_all(const Dataset *calibration, const Options *options, Evaluation *evaluations) {99    FILE *grid = fopen("reports/calibration_grid.csv", "w");100    size_t algorithm;101    int written;102    if (!grid) { perror("calibration grid"); return 0; }103    fputs("algorithm,threshold,margin,max_edits,correct_fuzzy,dangerous,rejected,coverage,weighted_cost\n", grid);104    for (algorithm = 0; algorithm < ALGORITHMS; ++algorithm) {105        evaluations[algorithm].policy = calibrate(calibration, algorithm, options->costs,106                                                  &evaluations[algorithm].calibration_cost, grid);107    }108    written = !ferror(grid);109    if (fclose(grid) != 0) written = 0;110    if (!written) fputs("Cannot write complete calibration grid\n", stderr);111    return written;112}113114int main(int argc, char **argv) {115    Options options = {.seed = 42, .repetitions = 5, .costs = {100, 1},116                       .report = "reports/evaluation.md", .csv = "reports/results.csv"};117    RequestedAction action = {0, 0};118    static Dataset calibration, held_out;119    static Evaluation evaluations[ALGORITHMS];120    size_t algorithm;121    CliResult arguments;122    registries_init();123    arguments = read_arguments(argc, argv, &options, &action);124    if (arguments == CLI_PRINTED_HELP) return 0;125    if (arguments == CLI_BAD_ARGUMENT) return 2;126    if (action.generate) {127        if (!generate_datasets(options.seed)) { fputs("dataset generation failed\n", stderr); return 1; }128        puts("Generated frozen calibration and held-out manifests.");129        return 0;130    }131    if (action.self_test) return self_test();132    if (!seed_matches("tests/calibration_cases.csv", options.seed) ||133        !seed_matches("tests/evaluation_cases.csv", options.seed)) {134        fputs("Manifest seed/version mismatch. Use --generate --seed N explicitly, then benchmark with the same seed.\n", stderr);135        return 1;136    }137    if (self_test()) return 1;138    if (!load_dataset("tests/calibration_cases.csv", &calibration)) return 1;139    if (!load_dataset("tests/evaluation_cases.csv", &held_out)) return 1;140    if (!validate_datasets(&calibration, &held_out)) return 1;141    puts("Calibrating policies using calibration data only...");142    fflush(stdout);143    /* Calibration writes every selected policy before evaluate sees held_out.144     * No later report or timing routine is allowed to replace those policies. */145    if (!calibrate_all(&calibration, &options, evaluations)) return 1;146    puts("Policies frozen. Evaluating held-out inputs and measuring runtime...");147    fflush(stdout);148    printf("%-7s %6s %6s %7s %7s %7s %9s\n", "Method", "Exact", "Fuzzy", "Unsafe", "Reject", "Cost", "10-key us");149    for (algorithm = 0; algorithm < ALGORITHMS; ++algorithm) {150        Metrics *metrics = &evaluations[algorithm].metrics;151        unsigned dangerous;152        evaluate(&held_out, algorithm, evaluations[algorithm].policy, &evaluations[algorithm]);153        benchmark_algorithm(algorithm, evaluations[algorithm].policy, &options, evaluations[algorithm].perf);154        dangerous = metrics->wrong + metrics->unknown_accept + metrics->ambiguous_accept;155        printf("%-7s %6u %6u %7u %7u %7.0f %9.3f\n", algorithms[algorithm].id, metrics->exact,156               metrics->fuzzy, dangerous, metrics->rejected, metric_cost(metrics, options.costs),157               evaluations[algorithm].perf[0].end.median_ns / 1000);158        fflush(stdout);159    }160    if (!generate_report(&options, &calibration, &held_out, evaluations)) { fputs("Report generation failed\n", stderr); return 1; }161    printf("Report: %s\nPer-case results: %s\n", options.report, options.csv);162    return 0;163}
